summary: Iteration 109 — client statuses (retail / wholesale), standard & individual conditions, managers (staff) CRUD, client binding, manager statistics and manager cabinet — fully tested end-to-end. Backend: 25/25 new tests pass in test_iter109_staff_managers.py plus full regression — test_iter108_features.py 16/16 (1 skip by design) + test_iter106_floor_individual_discount.py 13/13 all green. Covered: GET/PUT /api/admin/status-conditions (admin-only, validation negative/>100 → 422); GET /api/my-conditions (retail picks up standard discount, discount_individual=false, /auth/me reflects effective discount); POST/PUT/DELETE /api/admin/staff with duplicate-email (incl. existing client email, case-insensitive) → 400, short password → 422, bad email → 400, client → 403, empty password keeps current, new password works + old stops, blocked=true → login 401, soft delete hides manager from list, blocks login and frees the email; managers excluded from GET /api/admin/users; role guards — manager JWT gets 403 on /api/admin/staff, /api/admin/orders, /api/admin/conditions-requests; admin/client JWTs get 403 on /api/manager/overview /clients /chats; invalid period → 400. Binding: /admin/staff-clients?search finds client, POST /admin/staff/{id}/clients binds, GET lists them, client's /my-conditions returns manager info, DELETE unbinds (second DELETE → 404). Statistics (end-to-end): bound TEST_ client places an order on TEST_ product (price 1000, purchase 600, qty 2, cash) → order appears in /admin/staff/{id}/stats?period=day with correct revenue (goods=total-delivery_fee) and profit (revenue - qty*purchase_price) using purchase_price fallback when no stock_movement is present; commission_percent falls back to the standard manager commission and commission_individual=false, switches to individual commission_percent when set on the manager; cancelling the order removes it from stats; period=all works; period=xyz → 400. Conditions requests: empty request → 400, duplicate pending → 400, admin approve applies individual conditions and flips the client to wholesale (customer_status + individual_discount + deferral_days + credit_limit=approved), reject keeps retail, re-handling an already-decided request → 400. Manager cabinet (demo manager): /manager/overview period=month returns the full stats shape, /manager/clients includes the bound demo client with effective block; PUT /manager/clients/{foreign}/conditions → 404, validation >100 → 422, successful update writes the client's individual_discount (verified via /my-conditions), chats/{foreign}/messages → 404. Frontend smoke (admin, manager, client): admin-staff-link, admin-staff-page, staff-add-btn, staff-tab-requests, staff-modal with name/email/password/commission/save inputs all present; status-conditions settings sub-tab exposes status-conditions-retail/wholesale/manager cards and status-conditions-save; manager@avarus.ru login lands on /manager, manager-cabinet-link header link present, manager-tab-stats/-clients/-chats render, navigating to /admin/staff as manager is redirected away (403 on API, back to /); user@demo.com /account shows my-conditions-card with 'Оптовый клиент' badge, 10% discount, 0 ₽ delivery, 14 days deferral, 50 000 ₽ credit limit, 'Ваш менеджер: Демо Менеджер' and 'Запросить другие условия' button (my-manager + conditions-request-open-btn).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/orders.py: order documents now store manager_id but OrderResponse (models.py:286) does not expose it — the response always returns None. Fine for the current UI, but add manager_id to OrderResponse if the admin order list / detail should show which manager owns an order.

routes/staff.py delete_manager renames the email to 'deleted-<prefix>-<orig>' to free the address; confirmed working, but the past-orders snapshot keeps manager_id so a soft-deleted manager still shows up in historical stats. If the admin ever expects a 'manager removed' label in the UI, add a client-side lookup against deleted_at.

routes/staff.py _apply_individual_conditions always writes delivery_cost=None / deferral_days=0 / credit_limit=0 even on partial updates — the admin's PUT /admin/conditions-requests must send the full shape or previously-set individual fields will be wiped. Document this (the UI currently does send the full shape).
database.py effective_conditions coerces unknown customer_status values (e.g. legacy 'partner'/'b2b') to retail; server.py migration for these legacy statuses is relied upon and should stay.

routes/staff.py list_staff calls _manager_stats(detailed=False) per manager — N+1 queries on the orders/products/stock_movements collections. Cheap today, consider a single aggregate when managers > ~50.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin staff page + conditions settings + manager cabinet redirect + client my-conditions all render and are integrated)

seed_data_creation: Each test creates its own TEST_ records and cleans them up in the module-scoped tracked fixture: TEST_ managers (hard soft-deleted via DELETE /api/admin/staff), TEST_ clients registered via /auth/register (removed via DELETE /api/admin/users), one TEST_ product (deleted), one TEST_ order (cancelled to restore stock). Status conditions snapshot taken via GET /admin/status-conditions and restored to all-zero defaults in teardown. Demo manager's binding to user@demo.com and user@demo.com's individual conditions (individual_discount=10, delivery_cost=0, customer_status=wholesale) are restored after the manager-cabinet set-conditions test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_iter109_staff_managers.py uses dotenv-free env read: `os.environ.get('REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL')` — export it before running: `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=$(grep -oP 'REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=\K\S+' /app/frontend/.env)`; run with `-p no:xdist -o addopts=''`. The order's `manager_id` snapshot is NOT returned to API clients (OrderResponse schema omits it) — assert attribution via /admin/staff/{id}/stats listing the order, not by reading the field from the /orders POST response. Conditions_requests rows are left in the DB after approve/reject — there's no admin delete endpoint; the tests only create a few per run and they are harmless history.
